subject: Request: evidence for pre-join background checks & security training
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: security@clientcorp.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: evidence for pre-join background checks & security training

Hi Sasha / ClientCorp security team,

Thanks again for the SOC 2 readiness call last week. As part of your SIG/CAIQ review you asked for concrete artifacts that show how we handle pre-join vetting and baseline security training for new hires. Can you confirm the exact items you want, but below is what we plan to provide initially:

- LMS completion export (CSV) showing mandatory security modules for the past 12 months (user id, completion date, course id)
- Background check vendor summary with batch confirmations and date ranges (vendor redacted field mapping included)
- Current onboarding checklist snapshot (access gating, privileged-access request flow)
- Policy references: new-hire security agreement and training policy links

I'll attach a curated bundle in a separate email once we validate PII redaction. If you need signed vendor attestations or original PDFs from the background-check firm, please list that and we'll route to procurement.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
(attachment: planned-artefacts-list.txt)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Mar 2027 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: evidence for pre-join background checks & security training

Kimberly — quick status from my side:

- LMS export: I pulled a CSV for all hires since 2026-01-01 from the LMS. It includes user_id, name, email, course_id, completion_date. I'll scrub the employee DOB and SSN columns before finalizing. (file: LMS_completion_export_20270313.csv)
- Background checks: VerifySafe provided a summary PDF and a spreadsheet with batch IDs. They said original vendor reports can be provided to auditors under an NDA. I asked for a dated attestation from them and attached the summary we received. (file: BackgroundChecks_Summary_2026-2027.pdf)
- Onboarding checklist: snapshot attached; it shows the gating steps we enforce for access to infra accounts.

Questions for Vivek / Neha: do we want to include the active directory join timestamps or keep to HR/LMS artifacts only? ClientCorp's auditor sometimes asks for login provisioning events to validate access gating.

—Marissa
Senior People Ops Partner
Redwood Inference
(attachment: onboarding_checklist_snapshot_2027-03.xlsx)

On Mon, Mar 14, 2027 at 9:35 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Kimberly — quick status from my side:
> 
> - LMS export: I pulled a CSV for all hires since 2026-01-01 from the LMS. It includes user_id, name, email, course_id, completion_date. I'll scrub the employee DOB and SSN columns before finalizing. (file: LMS_completion_export_20270313.csv)
> - Background checks: VerifySafe provided a summary PDF and a spreadsheet with batch IDs. They said original vendor reports can be provided to auditors under an NDA. I asked for a dated attestation from them and attached the summary we received. (file: BackgroundChecks_Summary_2026-2027.pdf)
> - Onboarding checklist: snapshot attached; it shows the gating steps we enforce for access to infra accounts.

Thanks — please include the AD join timestamps. For SOC 2 scope we need proof that accounts were created after HR approval and training completion in a subset of cases. Provide a keyed extract (user id, provisioning timestamp, HR approval id) — no PII like DOB. Marissa, can you coordinate with IT to produce a redacted provisioning log extract?

I'll also reach out to VerifySafe to request a dated vendor attestation we can share with external auditors.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: security@clientcorp.com, audits@regulator.co

Subject: Fwd: Request: evidence for pre-join background checks & security training

Hi Sasha / Audit team — attaching the initial bundle for your review. Per our internal notes above, we've redacted PII fields and produced:

- LMS_completion_export_20270313.csv (redacted: no SSN/DOB)
- BackgroundChecks_Summary_2026-2027.pdf (summary from VerifySafe; vendor attestation requested)
- onboarding_checklist_snapshot_2027-03.xlsx (gating checklist)
- Provisioning_extract_sample.csv (user_id, provisioning_timestamp, hr_approval_id) — coming from IT (to follow within 48 hours)

If you need signed vendor attestations or raw vendor PDF reports, please confirm and we will trigger an NDA workflow with VerifySafe.

Next steps requested from ClientCorp: please confirm whether the artifacts above suffice for the CAIQ/SIG questions on pre-join vetting and mandatory training, or if you need additional logs (e.g., AD join events, MDM enrollment records).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
